retain zero raw dialogue in the P4-H trace
set final_visible_surface_matches_contract only from actual exact final equality
preserve ordinary chat third-person hypothetical quoted safety and action routing
do not change episode write memory schema ranking P4-F recall or the general persona prompt
verification_order: run the frozen contract and prechange-result binding test
